aws.cloudfront.ap.https_requests.note: HTTPS requests served from edges in Asia Pacific (Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, and others). Always free: 10,000,000 HTTP or HTTPS requests a month over every price zone together (https://aws.amazon.com/free/, Always free: Amazon CloudFront; the price list's Global-Requests-Tier1 grant, 0 to 10 million at $0); CloudFront is global, so the pool is the account

aws.cloudfront.ap.transfer_out.note: Data transfer out to viewers in Asia Pacific (Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, and others). Volume tiers count the account's transfer to the zone in a month: from 10 TB, 50 TB, 150 TB, 500 TB, 1 PB and 5 PB. Always free: 1 TB (1,024 GB) a month over every price zone together (https://aws.amazon.com/free/, Always free: Amazon CloudFront; the price list's Global-DataTransfer-Out-Bytes grant, 0 to 1,024 GB at $0)
